scripts.build: pnpm --filter @live-crm/shared build && pnpm --filter @live-crm/server build && pnpm --filter @live-crm/web build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @live-crm/server dev:api" "pnpm --filter @live-crm/server dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @live-crm/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @live-crm/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @live-crm/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @live-crm/web typecheck
